Coaching programmes

LESS GUESSING. MORE GOOD RALLIES.

Coaching built around the level you are at and the game you want to play.

Build the basics

Get comfortable with the racket, court positions and a shared rally. Start with simple patterns you can recognise in a game.

Develop your game

Work on shot choices, movement and communication with your partner. Bring a specific part of your game you want to improve.

Prepare to compete

Review match situations and practice with a clearer purpose. Discuss the format and goals you are preparing for.

PRACTICE WITH A PURPOSE.

A coaching session is more useful when the coach knows your experience, your goals and how you usually play.
